capstone.title: Motion Graphics Showreel
capstone.brief: Make a 30-second showreel: a logo reveal, a kinetic title, a social media animation, and a lower third. Each piece is animated, with sound, and edited into one video.
deliverables: A short note on each piece
A list of the effects used
A plan for your next showreel
